cases.title: Pocket visibility
cases.goal: Link two pocket views to the same AP5 ligand and record the representation, selection and saved camera.

steps.title: Import the example files
steps.instruction: Extract the input ZIP and read LAB_NOTES.txt beside the files/ folder. In ClaimTrace, click Choose files on the welcome page, or Start with files in an open package. Select all 7 files inside files/. Enter the package name below and click Create package.
steps.expected: The package opens in Prepare with 7 saved files and the figure visible.
steps.caption: Select the original figure and source files, then name the package.

steps.title: Write one figure statement
steps.instruction: Click Add claim. Enter the statement and figure label, choose Structure view, check both Linked scenes, and click Save claim.

fields.label: Figure statement
fields.value: Two views locate AP5 within the adenylate kinase pocket.

steps.expected: The statement appears in the left claim list and the figure stays linked.
steps.caption: The statement and figure label identify the claim linked to this view.

steps.title: Choose the supporting files
steps.instruction: Click Add evidence. Choose the Evidence type and select the listed Source files. Continue in this form for the next step.
steps.expected: The source counter shows 5 selected.
steps.caption: Choose files that support this particular statement.

steps.title: Record the finding and settings
steps.instruction: Enter the method under How was it checked? and the observation under What did you find? Open Analysis settings and complete Selections, cutoffs and sampling. Click Save evidence.

fields.label: How was it checked?
fields.value: Inspect the supplied pocket views, scene scripts and 1AKE coordinates.

fields.label: What did you find?
fields.value: Both supplied views show 1AKE chain A and AP5. The surface view exposes the pocket around the ligand.

fields.label: Selections, cutoffs and sampling
fields.value: Structure: PDB 1AKE, chain A; ligand: AP5. Pocket: whole residues with any atom within 4.2 angstrom of AP5.

steps.expected: The evidence record appears under Evidence & sources.
steps.caption: The evidence form records the method, observation and analysis settings.

steps.title: State the interpretation limit
steps.instruction: Click Add limitation. Enter the limitation and click Save limitation.

fields.label: What limits this conclusion?
fields.value: Pocket visibility depends on the representation and camera. Use the supplied PSE for the full saved view; the reduced PML records the structure and camera. Native-view replay remains pending.

steps.expected: Limitations shows 1 saved record.
steps.caption: The limitation records what affects interpretation of the figure.

steps.title: Review the short audit
steps.instruction: Click Review. Read the five rows of the Claim audit and confirm the evidence and limitation match the figure. Use the scene dropdown above the figure to choose 1_2_buried_pocket_surface.pml and inspect the second linked view.
steps.expected: Both saved views are recorded; scene replay remains pending.
steps.caption: Inspect the claim → visual evidence → provenance → uncertainty → reproducibility record.

steps.title: Check the draft export
steps.instruction: Click Export. Keep Working draft selected and confirm Draft checks passed.
steps.expected: Download package · ZIP is enabled.
steps.caption: Working draft includes the saved records and open questions.

steps.title: Download the package
steps.instruction: Click Download package · ZIP. Check your browser’s downloads for claimtrace-review.zip, then save it with your figure. The ZIP contains the source files, claim record and recipient instructions.
steps.expected: The page confirms: Export checks passed. Your browser will download the package.
steps.caption: The downloaded ZIP contains the entered claim, evidence, limitation, and original input files.

cases.outcome: A downloaded Working draft ZIP containing 1 claim, 1 evidence record, 1 limitation, and 7 source files.
open_questions: Reopen the original PSE files in PyMOL to check scene replay.
